msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia turquesa-elche-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a cream faux-leather jacket over a brown lace top and wide brown trousers from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the centre of Elche, Spain, with palm trees and classic buildings, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia turquesa-elche-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a rust-orange shirt with thin dark vertical stripes and a band collar, worn with light blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia turquesa-elche-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a black faux-leather biker jacket over a black lace camisole with wide black trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia turquesa-elche-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an ivory lace corset-style camisole top with wide taupe trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia turquesa-elche-34.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a camouflage print maxi skirt with a taupe short-sleeve top and a wide elastic corset belt with gold buttons from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
